scope: jobs/CI executors/native build/SNIX fallback command boundaries

finding.description: Legacy shell executor validation used lexical prefix checks and did not canonicalize a workspace child before current_dir, allowing symlink-based workspace escape if an attacker could place or select such a path.

remediation: Require absolute existing working-directory paths before execution.
Canonicalize requested path before workspace-prefix comparison.
Canonicalize configured workspace root before comparison when available.
Preserve tmpfs fallback only when both request spelling and canonical target remain under /tmp/ci-workspace-*.
Add positive canonical workspace child and negative symlink-escape regressions.
observations: CI shell payloads preserve structured command/args except when the pipeline explicitly configures a shell expression requiring sh -c.
VM payloads do not pass host checkout paths; source_hash is used for guest checkout recovery.
The split aspen-ci agent already canonicalized working directories before prefix checks.
Nix/SNIX fallback subprocesses inspected in this slice use Command::new and positional args rather than shell interpolation, and native SNIX build is preferred when available.
